text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected on service=rwd-inference, model=gptx-7b, region=us-west1. p95 increased to 420ms, p99 spike to 2.9s. Streaming stall rate +23%. Paging on-call.
Maya: acked — I'm on call. seeing the page. pulling up console now.
Jonathan: thanks. i saw traces showing spike started ~2023456500. any customers hitting errors?
Eli: support here — AcmeChat and BetaApp reported streaming timeouts and partial responses. AcmeChat screenshot: client-side stream stuck after first chunk.
Maya: under helm — opening runtime dashboard. router shows increased queuing on gpu-pool-usw1, busy nodes count +4.
Rob: tagging in eng-runtime. can you paste node logs? I suspect a hw issue.
Jen: infra monitoring shows thermal excursions and ECC spikes on node gpu-15 in pool-usw1. multiple ECC corrected errors and a GPU clock downshift at 2023456462.
Maya: copied: GPU15 is showing temperature 92C and a thermal throttling event.
Jonathan: if GPU is thermal-throttling, KV cache eviction could create tail stalls. we should drain that node.
InfraOps: creating drain ticket now: DR-2023-492. cordon + evict live tasks from gpu-15.
Maya: @InfraOps please also set routing fallback to model=gptx-7b-quantized on the affected route to reduce load by ~30%.
InfraOps: routing rule applied: fallback -> gptx-7b-quantized for route /v1/generate (all tenants).
Rob: collecting nvidia output from gpu-15:
```
$ nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,PS,DRIVER
GPU 0000:03:00.0
    Temperature
        GPU Current Temp : 92 C
        Temp Max         : 94 C
    ECC Errors
        Volatile:
            Single Bit   : 124
            Double Bit   : 3
    Power Readings:
        Power Draw : 295 W
        Power Cap  : 320 W
```
Maya: also seeing kernel oops lines in dmesg with `gpu_ring_timeout` and `cececc corrected error` messages.
Jonathan: okay plan: 1) drain gpu-15, 2) failover active sessions to other nodes and quantized variant, 3) enable short-term autoscale (burst add 2 nodes), 4) watch p99.
Eli: customer impact: AcmeChat SLA is 99.9% p99 3s. currently at 99.3% for last 15m. they're getting partial transcripts. I'd like comms ready if we go past 30m.
Rob: running live migration for requests from gpu-15 -> available nodes. kicking cache warmers to reduce cold-KV misses.
Maya: drain started at 2023456720, drain progress: 60% streams drained, batch jobs moved.
Jen: hardware team asked for runbook: we should collect `nvfan`, `journalctl -u driver.service`, and PCI bus error counters.
Jonathan: can we repro stall with local bench? Rob, can you run the streaming replay harness against the remaining pool with the same load?
Rob: starting replay now. baseline p99 before mitigation ~2.9s. with fallback quantized and extra nodes p99 target under 800ms.
incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff in 2h to Jonathan.
Maya: handing to Jonathan for long tail monitoring, I'm going to rotate off after confirming customers stable. key notes in thread.
Jonathan: ack. monitoring graphs show p95 back to 180ms, p99 trending down to 760ms after routing changes. streaming stall rate down to +3%.
Eli: AcmeChat reports improvement; they saw continuous streaming for last 10 minutes. tagging account team for postmortem comms.
Jen: hardware flagged GPU15 as flaky, recommend replacing board. scheduling RMA.
InfraOps: node gpu-15 marked quarantined in inventory. autoscale added 2 nodes at 2023456798.
Rob: replay shows two small regressions at high concurrency related to quantized model accuracy sampling, but latency is within SLO. i'll open a follow-up to tune batch-config.
Jonathan: closing immediate incident: mitigation succeeded, drainage complete at 2023456845. leaving monitoring. we'll file a postmortem and include customer impact and timelines.
Maya: thank you everyone. tagging follow-ups: PM for comms, eng-runtime for batch tuning, infra for RMA. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, impacted_customers=["AcmeChat","BetaApp"], started=2023456460, mitigated=2023456845.
Jonathan: adding todo: add better automated detection for ECC-correlation -> immediate cordon/evict, and a playbook entry for quantized fallback.
Eli: I'll prepare draft comms and follow-up with AcmeChat.
Maya: handover complete.
Jonathan: last check at 2023456860: metrics stable. closing thread but keeping alerting on for 2h.
